mapper.sql: verification_id AS verificationId, email AS email, purpose AS purpose, code_hash AS codeHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, failed_attempts AS failedAttempts, verified_at AS verifiedAt, token_hash AS tokenHash, token_expires_at AS tokenExpiresAt, token_used_at AS tokenUsedAt, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verifications (email, purpose, code_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY created_at DESC, verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND created_at >= #{since}
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1 WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId}
UPDATE email_verifications SET token_used_at = #{usedAt} WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND token_used_at IS NULL
